1	import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
2	import type { Logger } from './logger';
3	
4	export interface ClientOptions {
5	  baseUrl: string;
6	  retries?: number;
7	}
8	
9	export type Handler = (req: Request) => Promise<Response>;
10	
11	export class ApiClient {
12	  private readonly retries: number;
13	
14	  constructor(private readonly options: ClientOptions, private readonly log: Logger) {
15	    this.retries = options.retries ?? 3;
16	  }
17	
18	  async getUser(id: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<unknown> {
19	    const url = `${this.options.baseUrl}/getUser/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
20	    for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= this.retries; attempt++) {
21	      const response = await fetch(url, init);
22	      if (response.ok) return response.json();
23	      this.log.warn('getUser failed', { attempt, status: response.status });
24	      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2 ** attempt * 100));
25	    }
26	    throw new Error('getUser: retries exhausted');
27	  }
28	
29	  async listOrders(id: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<unknown> {
30	    const url = `${this.options.baseUrl}/listOrders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
31	    for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= this.retries; attempt++) {
32	      const response = await fetch(url, init);
33	      if (response.ok) return response.json();
34	      this.log.warn('listOrders failed', { attempt, status: response.status });
35	      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2 ** attempt * 100));
36	    }
37	    throw new Error('listOrders: retries exhausted');
38	  }

195	
196	export const buildHeaders = (input: Record<string, string>): Record<string, string> => {
197	  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
198	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
199	    out[key.toLowerCase()] = value.trim();
200	  }
201	  return out;
202	};
203

205	  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
206	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
207	    out[key.toLowerCase()] = value.trim();
208	  }
209	  return out;
210	};

276	export function loadFixture(path: string): Promise<string> {
277	  return readFile(path, 'utf8');
278	}
